status: DRAFT for Gate 0 - not frozen. Freezing (with SHA-256 recorded in STATUS.md) happens at Gate 2.
question: Does the merged method (U2/LLM/SMOTE candidates -> RC-QASyn quality gate -> utility-aware selection) improve minority-class F1 on REAL TEST over tuned no oversampling and over U2 alone, across the 40 benchmark datasets?
claims_policy: Only the tests declared under 'statistics' may be reported as tests. No state-of-the-art wording. Exact-match diagnostics are copying diagnostics, not privacy results. A miss is reported as found.

datasets.dev: 9 KEEL datasets from Empirical v2 / addendum v1 (method design and tuning only)
datasets.benchmark_u2_core: 30 OpenML datasets, ml_ugo@a6710ea catalogue numbers 1-32 excluding 10 and 26; kept as-is; 7 flagged for < 30 minority TEST records
datasets.benchmark_new: 10 proposed in sources.json (role 'benchmark', proposal 'Gate 0'); 3 reserves; rejections with reasons
open_at_gate_0: approve the 10 new datasets (GiveMeSomeCredit is a Kaggle-competition source; licence to confirm) or swap in reserves
dev page-blocks0 (KEEL) and benchmark page-blocks (OpenML 1021) share a source table: drop page-blocks0 from dev, or keep and report
six addendum-v1 KEEL dev files are not on this machine; hand placement needed

splits.validation: stratified 20% of TRAIN, carved per outer split; every tuning choice uses validation only
splits.test: REAL TEST used only for final evaluation; no benchmark TEST metric for the merged method before Gate 2
splits.u2_comparability_note: U2's own benchmark uses seeds 42/43/44 with the same 80/20 + 20% validation fractions; Study v3 reruns U2/UGO on the Study v3 seeds rather than reusing U2's published numbers

llm.price_cards: study/v3/pricing.py (read from provider pages 2026-10-31; re-check before the Phase 3 pilot)
all_benchmark: gpt-6-luna (plan text says GPT-6.1-luna, which OpenAI does not list; Gate 0 decision)
muse-spark-1.3 (standard endpoint; content not used for training)

request_settings.anthropic: no temperature/top_p (non-default values are rejected by Haiku 5.5 / Sonnet 5.5), no seed parameter; thinking off at effort low (Haiku: disabled; Sonnet: between_tools)
request_settings.openai: seed per batch; reasoning_effort none (luna) / low (terra, pending verification)
request_settings.meta: seed per batch; reasoning_effort minimal (reasoning cannot be disabled); reasoning tokens logged separately

llm.seeds: per-batch seeds via rcqasyn generation_provider_seed (where the provider accepts a seed)
llm.batch_api: used for Anthropic and OpenAI; Meta documents no batch API
llm.prompt_note: a new versioned generation prompt under study/v3/prompts/ (never editing prompts/); same prompt and TRAIN-only context for all generators; drafted in Phase 1-2

non_llm: U2 (FlowGMM gate) and paper-derived UGO from ml_ugo@a6710ea (UGO_30_Datasets.ipynb sha256 a888d9708a9f36db36c6febd65314a2464d175cbb59a632e68d363aa4ab9e541), SMOTE/SMOTENC

budget_caps_usd.stop_rule: stop and ask before cumulative spend of any provider passes 80% of its cap (enforced in study/v3/budget.py)

record_budget_note: per dataset/split budget rule to be set from the Phase 1 quota ablation (50% minority vs real ratio); all comparators at the same record budget

comparators.merged: U2/LLM/SMOTE candidates -> RC-QASyn quality gate -> utility-aware selection
comparators.baseline_rule: B1/B2/B3 are research controls and are not modified

utility_term_candidates: U2 anchor difficulty percentile x group stability (U2 eqs. 5-8)
FlowGMM compatibility as a separate admission evidence column (never merged into the concern index)

classifiers.search_spaces: ml_ugo@a6710ea notebooks/portable_ugo/models.py _SPACES via candidate_parameters (default first, N_CANDIDATES=10)

metrics.primary: minority-class F1 on REAL TEST, decision threshold selected on validation (as in U2)

statistics.unit: dataset (mean over 5 splits, then over classifiers - aggregation order to freeze at Gate 2)
tests: Wilcoxon signed-rank vs each comparator with Holm correction
median paired difference with bootstrap 95% interval

success_criterion_proposed: median F1 gain of the merged method over tuned no oversampling and over U2 alone is positive with Holm-adjusted p < 0.05 across the 40 benchmark datasets, with no significant MCC loss against either. Final wording and size target fixed at Gate 2.
human_labels: team labels a blinded sample; the agent prepares files only and never fills label columns
